risks.risk: Wrong fitment (pin count/gearbox type/vehicle model mismatch). The photo doesn’t show the exact transmission variant.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the gearbox ID plate/label (or stamped code) and the connector/pin count on the end, plus the vehicle make/model it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: wrong fitment risk (treated like a generic used gearbox with uncertain compatibility).

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working (could have internal wear, leaks, or gear noise).
risks.proof: Request a short video of it running under load (or at least spinning/engaging) and/or a mechanic’s test report showing it engages all gears.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (treated as not working/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Missing parts or damage not visible (mounting brackets, sensors, seals, output shaft condition).
risks.proof: Request photos of all sides, the mounting points, output/input splines, and any included accessories; include close-ups of seals and connectors.

risks.risk: Seller’s 'motor speed reducer' description may not match the actual item (industrial reducer vs car gearbox).
risks.proof: Ask for the exact part name from the donor vehicle or a part number cross-reference, plus a photo of any markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case mismatch to the buyer’s intended use.

proof_requests: Clear photo of any ID plate/stamped code and the exact pin count/connector type (for compatibility).
Video of the unit being tested (engagement/spinning under load) or a mechanic’s test confirmation.
Photos of all sides including mounting points, output/input splines, seals, and any included sensors/brackets.
